• West Valley Symphony’s Desert Rose String Quartet - March 18
• Hometown Heroes Barbershop Quartet - April 22
Lunchtime Theater returns for a new season of entertainment at the Arts HQ Gallery, 16126 N. Civic Center Plaza in Surprise.
Enjoy live musical entertainment surrounded by art while breaking up your day in the West Valley. The season runs October through April, with performances noon-1 p.m., one Thursday a month. Catch all the Lunchtime Theater shows and save with a season pass.
Open seating begins at 11:30 a.m. Each performance runs noon-1 p.m. Attend all seven Lunchtime Theater performances for the season at a discounted price for $120 (regularly $20/person per show).
Presented by the West Valley Arts Council and hosted at the Arts HQ Gallery, Lunchtime Theater is a seasonal musical and theater performance program to enrich West Valley communities. Visual and performing arts include Arizona talent from local jazz groups to the West Valley Symphony’s string quartet performances.
Ticket reservations are required in advance. Complementary soft drinks are provided by the Credit Union West of Surprise. Attendees may bring their own lunch or go to one of the many local restaurants in Surprise before or after the concert.
For tickets, call 623-584-2626 or go to westvalleyarts.org/theater .
